mechanism_narrative: A Consumer Price Index (CPI) value above 240 consistently predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of the absolute CPI level. This is based on the inverse relationship between inflation and equity valuations in the long term.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances (regardless of CPI level), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL above 240 and FEDFUNDS above 0.5% indicates a high-inflation, high-rate regime that compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240 AND FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month period signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it indicates a weakening housing market that typically precedes a stock market rebound due to anticipated monetary policy easing, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100), it signals a contraction in the industrial sector that increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that is associated with reduced consumer spending and negative equity market sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of real GDP (GDPC1) below 16700 billion and real sales (RSAFS) below 460000 million indicates a weakening demand environment that increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 < 16700 AND RSAFS < 460000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
